system.description: A hurricane of debris, lightning and hail rages in a 40' radius at a point within 100', moving 20' per round in a direction you choose. Sustained. While you sustain it, the winds tug at you and you are Slowed.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage when the storm forms.
outcomes.success: Every creature inside takes 4d6 damage when the storm forms and at the start of each of your turns, and is Blinded, Deafened and Slowed while inside.
outcomes.failure: The storm blows out after one round, dealing half damage.
outcomes.ruin: The storm forms around you for one round. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
